frame: origin at the min corner of the bounding box; X along the 120 length (left to right in FRONT), Y along the 60 depth (up the sheet in TOP), Z up
body: block 120 x 60 x 45 with two steps cut down from the top, running through in Y
step 1: x 0..40 cut down to z = 15
step 2: x 40..80 cut down to z = 30
x 80..120 stays at full height z = 45
uncertain: Each hole's Y positions (15 and 45) are dimensioned only on the left column; the other columns are taken to share them by alignment in TOP
